function.name: GetMetadata
function.comment: Queries MP3 stream properties and optional text tags without creating a Sound object.
function.prototype: ERR mp3::GetMetadata(STRVIEW Path, MPF Flags, STRING * XML)

input.param: Optional flags that enable tag parsing and more costly duration calculations.

description.p: GetMetadata() opens the file at Path for reading and inspects the first MPEG Layer III frame that follows any ID3v2 tag. The audio is not decoded, so the call is considerably cheaper than creating an MP3 object when only the stream properties are needed. The result is returned in XML as a single document in the following form:
description.pre: <mp3 sampleRate="44100" channels="2" bitrate="128000"> <duration seconds="215.432000" source="xing" estimated="false"/> <tags> <title>...</title><artist>...</artist><album>...</album> <track>...</track><year>...</year><genre>...</genre> </tags> </mp3>
description.p: The output is not indented in practice. The sampleRate, channels and bitrate attributes are taken from the first audio frame; bitrate is expressed in bits per second and does not represent the average rate of a VBR stream.
The duration element reports the playback length in seconds, with source indicating how it was obtained:

list.li: xing: Read from a Xing or Info header in the first frame. This source is always used when available, regardless of Flags, and is corrected for the encoder delay and padding recorded in a LAME extension.
scan: Calculated by reading every frame header in the file. Requires SCAN and is accurate for both CBR and VBR streams, but the cost is proportional to the file size.
estimate: Derived from the compressed audio size and the bitrate of the first frame. Requires ESTIMATE and is unreliable for VBR streams. The estimated attribute is true only for this source.

description.p: If no source is available, the duration element is omitted.

When TAGS is set, the tags element lists the title, artist, album, track, year and genre values that are present. Values from ID3v2.2, ID3v2.3 and ID3v2.4 text frames take precedence, and an ID3v1 trailer fills any values that remain missing, including the ID3v1.1 track number and the ID3v1 genre name. Text is converted to UTF-8 and XML-escaped; only the first value of a multi-value frame is reported, trailing spaces are removed and empty values are omitted. ID3v2 values such as TCON genre references and TDRC timestamps are reported as stored. Compressed or encrypted frames are ignored, and tag parsing is skipped if the ID3v2 block exceeds 1 MiB. The tags element is omitted if no values are found.
XML is cleared on entry and is only populated if the call succeeds. Errors raised by the underlying File operations are returned to the caller unchanged.

result.error: The ID3v2 tag is malformed, the Xing header gives a non-positive length, or a scan lost frame sync.
Path is empty or contains a null byte, or Flags contains an unrecognised value.
The file is too small or no MPEG Layer III frame was found where the audio data begins.
The file could not be opened for reading.
